records.jp: あ……<CR>金魚すくい、やりたい
records.en_original: Ooh, I wanna try goldfish scooping!
records.en: Ooh, I wanna try goldfish scooping!

records.jp: ちょっと待って
おっけー。<CR>金魚たち、嫌がってない
records.en_original: That's good. It appears that the goldfish won't mind.
records.en: That's good. It appears that the goldfish won't mind.

records.jp: んじゃ、勝負でもしてみる？
records.en_original: How about we have a little competition?
records.en: How about we have a little competition?

records.jp: 勝負、する。<CR>愛央はその言葉、後悔するだろう
records.en_original: Very well. I'll make you regret those words.
records.en: Very well. I'll make you regret those words.

records.jp: 手加減なしだからね！
その心意気やよし
では、すくった数で勝負だ
records.en_original: The one who scoops the most will be the winner.
records.en: The one who scoops the most will be the winner.

records.jp: おう！
えーと、お手柔らかにお願いします
records.en_original: Uh... Mind going easy on me?
records.en: Uh... Mind going easy on me?

records.jp: 勝負に手加減などはない。<CR>死ぬ気で、かかってこい
records.en_original: Absurd. I shall do no such thing. This is a fight to the death.
records.en: Absurd. I shall do no such thing. This is a fight to the death.

records.jp: 熱血格闘漫画！？
records.en_original: What is this, a tournament arc or something?!
records.en: What is this, a tournament arc or something?!

records.jp: ……よし！　やっと一匹すくえた！
むう……！　きららだって……
おおっ！　きららも、すくえた！
１対１……面白くなってきた！
records.en_original: One to one, huh... I like a challenge!
records.en: One to one, huh... I like a challenge!

records.jp: 勝利は渡さない
私だって！！
うおおおおーーーー！！
あー！　破れたあ！
うぅ……きららのも
じゃあ、同点ってことかぁ
もう一回やる？
いや、きららの腕はもう限界。<CR>これ以上やれば、腕が暴走する恐れがある
records.en_original: I'll have to decline. My arms are at their limit. If I overwork them anymore, I am bound to lose control of them.
records.en: I'll have to decline. My arms are at their limit. If I overwork them anymore, I am bound to lose control of them.

records.jp: （つまり、疲れたんだな）
勝負は、次に持ち越しかな
うん。<CR>次こそは、きららが勝つ
私だって、そのつもりだよ！
records.en_original: No way, I'm gonna come out on top next time!
records.en: No way, I'm gonna come out on top next time!

records.jp: さーてと、そろそろ行こっか
records.en_original: Whew, shall we call it a day?
records.en: Whew, shall we call it a day?

records.jp: ん？<CR>私の金魚が気になる？
records.en_original: Hm? Is there something wrong with my goldfish?
records.en: Hm? Is there something wrong with my goldfish?

records.jp: 愛央の金魚、キャリコ模様のバランスが<CR>すごくいい。もはや芸術の粋……<CR>
records.en_original: No, I was just thinking how its patterning is perfectly balanced. It's like the artistic ideal of a goldfish...
records.en: No, I was just thinking how its patterning is perfectly balanced. It's like the artistic ideal of a goldfish...

records.jp: （よくわかんないけど……<CR>この金魚が、気に入ったってことかな？）
records.en_original: (I'm not quite sure what she's talking about, but I think she's taken a liking to my goldfish.)
records.en: (I'm not quite sure what she's talking about, but I think she's taken a liking to my goldfish.)

records.jp: 交換する？
……いや、いい
きっとこの金魚はご縁があって愛央の元へ来た
records.en_original: I am sure that fate brought you that goldfish.
records.en: I am sure that fate brought you that goldfish.

records.jp: きららの金魚も同じ
records.en_original: Just like it did with mine.
records.en: Just like it did with mine.

records.jp: そのご縁を無下にするのは<CR>神様にもこの金魚にも失礼
records.en_original: To disregard such fate would be an affront to the gods and to our goldfish.
records.en: To disregard such fate would be an affront to the gods and to our goldfish.

records.jp: ……そっか。<CR>そうだよね
私もこの子大事にしよっと
records.en_original: I'm gonna take care of you, little guy.
records.en: I'm gonna take care of you, little guy.

records.jp: ふふーん、いいでしょ！
う……き、きららのだって可愛い！
records.en_original: Hrk... W-well mine's just as cute!
records.en: Hrk... W-well mine's just as cute!

records.jp: ほら、泳ぐ時の勢いが良い。<CR>立派に育つ証拠だ
records.en_original: Here, observe how strongly it swims. It will surely only grow stronger.
records.en: Here, observe how strongly it swims. It will surely only grow stronger.

records.jp: ふふっ、さっそく親バカになってる
フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
